remarks:
Showstopping Tonawanda ranch with incredible curb appeal and a bright, open-concept interior showcasing sophisticated mid-century modern style! Oversized front windows fill the home with natural light while adding striking architectural character. New laminate flooring flows seamlessly through the living room, dining area, and kitchen, complemented by brand-new mid-century-inspired lighting and thoughtfully selected designer finishes.

The stylish dining room makes a statement with a striking mid-century chandelier and designer wallpaper that beautifully ties together the home’s rich color palette. The stunning new kitchen features quartz countertops, an undermount sink, matte-gold hardware and faucet, updated electrical, and an upscale multi-toned blue glass backsplash.

Three generously sized bedrooms offer excellent closet space. BONUS: A spacious family room with a wood-burning stove, brand-new carpeting, and a tiled entry leading to the yard provides even more room for relaxing and entertaining. A convenient utility room for your washer and dryer.

The exterior is equally impressive, featuring fresh paint, new lighting, beautiful new landscaping, a rebuilt front entryway, and a BRAND-NEW TEAR-OFF ROOF! Additional highlights include central air, a garage, and a covered side patio. Magazine-worthy design, thoughtful updates, and exceptional living space make this unforgettable ranch truly move-in ready!
facts: Separate Formal Dining Room, Entrance Foyer, Eat In Kitchen, Separate Formal Living Room, Quartz Counters, Bedroom On Main Level, Programmable Thermostat
